title: Efficient Production of Human Hematopoietic Cells from Pluripotent Stem Cells through cAMP Induction
protocol: Plate MEFs on 0.1% gelatin-coated plates.
Incubate the plates with gelatin for 20 min at 37°C.
Use DMEM-high glucose with 10% FBS as MEF culture medium.
Seed 0.2 x 10^6 MEFs per well in a 6-well plate or 1 x 10^6 MEFs per 10 cm plate.
Mark differentiated and dark-centered ES colonies for removal.
Remove unwanted ES colonies with an aspirator.
Wash the plates once with PBS.
Incubate cells with Collagenase type IV at 37°C for 5 min.
Aspirate collagenase and wash once with ES medium.
Add 1 ml of ES medium to the cells.
Scrape the cells with a scraper and triturate gently thrice with a 1 ml pipette.
Distribute the ES cells equally on MEFs.
Remove media from ESCs in 10 cm dishes.
Wash ESCs once with PBS.
Add Dispase at a final concentration of 0.5 mg/ml in DMEM/F12, using 5 ml per plate.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 30 minutes (tap the plate every 10 min, 10 min, 5 min, 5 min).
Collect cells into a 50 ml tube.
Add 15 ml of DMEM/F12 to wash and allow cells to sink.
Wash one more time in the same manner to remove Dispase.
Add 10 ml of Mesototal medium to the collected cells.
Plate detached ESCs in ultra-low attachment 10 cm dishes (Day 0 of blood differentiation protocol).
Change complete media with 100% Mesototal on Day 1 and Day 2.
Perform a 50% media change using Mesototal on Day 4 and Day 6 to supply fresh growth factors.
Plate EBs onto 0.08 μg/mm² Matrigel in 6-well tissue culture plates at day 8.
Exchange half of the medium with fresh Mesototal medium on day 10 and day 12.
Continue differentiation towards hematopoietic cells until day 14 in MesoTotal medium.
Apply fresh medium for cell culture.
Induce cAMP with 10 μM forskolin and 500 μM IBMX on days 10 and 12 of differentiation.
Collect media containing EBs in a 15 ml tube, let the EBs sink, and aspirate media.
Wash EBs twice with 1 ml PBS.
Add 1 ml Tryple to the EBs, incubate for 5 minutes, and triturate 3 times.
Incubate for another 5-8 minutes, triturate 10 times, and collect cells.
Add DMEM+10%FCS to wash and collect remaining EBs.
Transfer collected cells/EBs slowly into a 5 ml syringe fitted with a 21G needle.
Pass through the syringe 4 times inclined to tube’s wall.
Push cells through a cell strainer fitted on top of a new 15 ml tube.
Flush the cell strainer with 3 ml PBS+2%FCS to collect any remaining cells.
Spin down the collected cells, resuspend in 1 ml PBS+2%FCS, and count cells.
Proceed for FACS or CFU assay.
